description: NaZr₂N₂SCl crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. Na is bonded to three equivalent S and three equivalent Cl atoms to form NaS₃Cl₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent ZrN₄Cl₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with six equivalent NaS₃Cl₃ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent ZrN₄Cl₃ trigonal pyramids. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.76 Å. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to four N and three equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted ZrN₄Cl₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaS₃Cl₃ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaS₃Cl₃ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ZrN₄Cl₃ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. There is one shorter (2.07 Å) and three longer (2.15 Å) Zr-N bond lengths. All Zr-Cl bond lengths are 3.01 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four N and three equivalent S atoms. There are three shorter (2.20 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Zr-N bond length. All Zr-S bond lengths are 2.73 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to four Zr atoms to form NZr₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NZr₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NZr₄ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-45°. In the second N site, N is bonded to four Zr atoms to form NZr₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NZr₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NZr₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-51°. S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Zr atoms to form SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NZr₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NZr₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, edges with six equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NZr₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. Cl is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Zr atoms to form distorted ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NZr₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NZr₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, edges with six equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NZr₄ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°.
